# Quality control (v3 pipeline re-run)

Redone using the v3 pipeline's own binomial p-value / methylation-ratio site
calling, swept over a small cutoff grid, with MultiQC and motif checks per
round. See [Pipeline overview](https://xsun1229.github.io/camseq-m6a/pipeline_overview.html)
for what changed vs. the docs above.

[QC -- round 1+2, from Pingluan (v3 pipeline)](https://xsun1229.github.io/camseq-m6a/QC_round1_2_PW_v3.html)

[QC -- round 3, from Jiahao (v3 pipeline)](https://xsun1229.github.io/camseq-m6a/QC_round3_JL_v3.html)

[QC -- round 5, from Jiahao (v3 pipeline)](https://xsun1229.github.io/camseq-m6a/QC_round5_JL_v3.html)
